request: Create a close-reading lesson on whether an extracted quotation supports a proposed policy claim. Students should quote enough context to preserve a negation and explain what recommendation remains open.
objective: Preserve negation and conditional scope when using a source as evidence.

sources.text: Fictional planning memo: “We do not recommend closing the workshop this month. If the roof inspection later identifies unsafe beams, temporary closure should be considered. The inspection has not yet taken place.”
A circulated summary quotes “recommend closing the workshop this month” and claims the memo ordered an immediate closure.
The packet contains no inspection result and no later decision. A separate office repainting schedule is irrelevant to the workshop roof.
